items.prompt: An old enamel kitchen colander held up by an anonymous hand against the night sky, seen from below. Starlight shines through its pattern of small holes, so the holes look like a star field, and beyond its rim the real Milky Way continues the same pattern. Quiet, still, a single cold point of light at the centre.

alt.ru: Старый эмалированный дуршлаг поднят к ночному небу: свет звёзд проходит через отверстия, и узор дырочек продолжается Млечным Путём.
alt.en: An old enamel colander held up to the night sky: starlight shines through its holes, and the pattern continues into the Milky Way.
alt.pt: Um velho escorredor esmaltado erguido contra o céu noturno: a luz das estrelas atravessa os furos e o padrão continua na Via Láctea.
alt.es: Un viejo colador esmaltado alzado contra el cielo nocturno: la luz de las estrellas pasa por los agujeros y el dibujo continúa en la Vía Láctea.

items.prompt: Two rectangular glass photographic plates lie side by side on an observatory archive light table. The left plate shows a stained slice of brain cortex: branching neurons and fine fibres. The right plate shows a simulated cosmic web: filaments of galaxies meeting at bright knots around dark voids. At this distance the two plates look almost identical. Hairline plate edges, dust, quiet darkness around them.

alt.ru: Две стеклянные пластинки на световом столе: слева срез коры мозга с ветвящимися нейронами, справа космическая паутина галактик. Издали их не отличить.
alt.en: Two glass plates on a light table: on the left a slice of brain cortex with branching neurons, on the right the cosmic web of galaxies. From a distance they look the same.
alt.pt: Duas placas de vidro numa mesa de luz: à esquerda um corte do córtex com neurónios ramificados, à direita a teia cósmica de galáxias. De longe parecem iguais.
alt.es: Dos placas de vidrio sobre una mesa de luz: a la izquierda un corte de corteza cerebral con neuronas ramificadas, a la derecha la red cósmica de galaxias. De lejos parecen iguales.

alt.ru: Старинная карта Северной Европы: берега, горы, а в море нарисованы чудовища и корабли.
alt.en: An old map of northern Europe: coastlines and mountains, with sea monsters and ships drawn in the ocean.
alt.pt: Um mapa antigo do norte da Europa: costas e montanhas, com monstros marinhos e navios desenhados no oceano.
alt.es: Un mapa antiguo del norte de Europa: costas y montañas, con monstruos marinos y barcos dibujados en el océano.

caption.ru: Олаус Магнус. Carta marina, 1539: берег проверен, горы видели издалека, а в море — чудовища.
caption.en: Olaus Magnus, Carta marina, 1539: the coast surveyed, the mountains seen from afar, and monsters at sea.
caption.pt: Olaus Magnus, Carta marina, 1539: a costa verificada, as montanhas vistas de longe e monstros no mar.
caption.es: Olaus Magnus, Carta marina, 1539: la costa comprobada, las montañas vistas de lejos y monstruos en el mar.
